Q1: Where should `/reclarify` at the start of a later line count? A first-line command would continue to count as it does today.
Choices:
A. Only on issues waiting for a human answer, as described in the progress comment. (RECOMMENDED)
B. On every open issue with a trusted, marker-free comment.
Q2: Is the 15-minute answered-but-unrouted detector part of this issue?
Choices:
A. Yes, for any newer trusted, non-automation comment, as the issue describes. (RECOMMENDED)
B. No, defer it to the separate plan named in the progress comment.
